REAL.rule: public.reality_ledger row with status='REAL' exists where (tokens(system+component) ∩ tokens(item.title+body)) ≥ 3
REAL.implies: runtime evidence present; safe to close_completed if item is an issue/PR

rules: artifact_only_no_runtime_receipt: GitHub issue/PR/commit exists but no ledger match
in_flight: work_queue row has heartbeat within last 10 min, not yet terminal
PARTIAL.implies: work in progress; do not close; surface in oldest_unresolved if stale

rules: missing-permission: caller lacks GH scope, IAM role, or RLS grant
missing-secret: required key absent from cap_secrets or env
missing-route: ops.destination_routes has no entry resolving to a callable target
missing-worker: Lambda not deployed or work_queue row never dispatched (last_heartbeat NULL after first attempt window)
missing-runtime: external service unreachable (supabase REST, AWS Lambda, bridge)
dependency-failure: upstream job failed and this job depends on it
BLOCKED.implies: must name a bounded blocker; never PRETEND

PRETEND.implies: if classification would be PRETEND, demote to PARTIAL or BLOCKED with bounded reason

non_destructive_actions_allowed: POST issue comment with new evidence only
destructive_actions_prohibited: PATCH issue state=closed without operator authority
